verdict.rationale: Chargebee's Dunning feature sends automated email reminders asking customers to update payment details and schedules payment retries, including smart retries that adapt to hard and soft declines. Docs also show subscriptions can be cancelled for non-payment (subscription_cancelled event), so the core automated sequence is evidenced. Missing for 10: email branding/customization, in-app banners, configurable grace periods, a configurable final-state choice (cancel vs unpaid), and independent hands-on corroboration.
